_meta.notes: Owned by readyup-practice (ships only in the practice component, next to the core's engine-surface.json). The grenade projectile factories behind ru_api grenade_spawn (API 1.12). Each Create is what CS2's own point_script SpawnGrenadeProjectile() calls (the caller_string anchor), with the same arguments: (const Vector* origin, const QAngle* angles, const Vector* velocity, const Vector* angular_velocity, CBaseEntity* thrower_pawn_or_null, int item_def_index); smoke takes a 7th int (team), HE gets 3.0f in xmm0 like the script call. The signatures cover the prologue's argument moves, so a changed ABI stops matching. None is in any plugin's needs.json "surface": a break turns off grenade spawning only (grenade_spawn_available() = 0), never the practice plugin. Check with build/readyup_sigcheck <libserver.so> gamedata/engine-surface.json gamedata/engine-surface.practice.json.

CSmokeGrenadeProjectile_Create.description: CSmokeGrenadeProjectile::Create(origin, angles, velocity, angVelocity, thrower, itemDefIndex, team) -> CSmokeGrenadeProjectile*. Called (not hooked) by ru_api grenade_spawn. Item 45.

CFlashbangProjectile_Create.description: CFlashbangProjectile::Create(origin, angles, velocity, angVelocity, thrower, itemDefIndex) -> CFlashbangProjectile*. Called (not hooked) by ru_api grenade_spawn. Item 43. Same prologue as the decoy's except the frame size (sub rsp, 8).

CHEGrenadeProjectile_Create.description: CHEGrenadeProjectile::Create(origin, angles, velocity, angVelocity, thrower, itemDefIndex) -> CHEGrenadeProjectile*. Called (not hooked) by ru_api grenade_spawn. Item 44.

CMolotovProjectile_Create.description: CMolotovProjectile::Create(origin, angles, velocity, angVelocity, thrower, itemDefIndex) -> CMolotovProjectile*. Called (not hooked) by ru_api grenade_spawn. Item 46 = molotov, 48 = incendiary (the script calls it with both). Builds the entity from keyvalues (classname / item_definition_index / origin / angles / owner) through the entity spawner.
